trigger: No accepted semantic owner/rule establishes the proposed generated demographic or biographical fact
comparability_action: Return typed missing actor-fact authority; comparator does not run
provenance_required: Requested actor fact kind; searched/required owner authority; comparator request
downstream_semantics: Not evidence that actor lacks the property; no empirical conditioner

trigger: Actor fact kind is governed but value is unknown at requested reference time
provenance_required: Actor fact ref/state; effective time; owner authority
downstream_semantics: Unknown is not wildcard, average person, or unconditioned population

trigger: Required generated fact record is absent and absence is not an explicit governed value
provenance_required: Required fact kind; actor/run/time; owner authority
downstream_semantics: Missing record != negative fact != comparator valid-empty

trigger: Actor owner explicitly governs absence/none as a real actor fact
comparability_action: Compare only if target rule explicitly maps the negative fact to an empirical value/state
provenance_required: Actor negative fact; comparator rule; empirical negative category authority
downstream_semantics: May yield a predicate only when negative-category equivalence is explicit

trigger: Candidate survey field exists or is suggested but no semantic authority for the coordinate/construct was demonstrated
provenance_required: Actor fact; candidate native field; missing empirical authority search
downstream_semantics: No inference from schema/name alone

trigger: Coordinate is governed generally but not available/applicable for selected source/wave/country
comparability_action: Return no comparator for this scope
provenance_required: Coordinate authority; source/wave/country scope; availability/applicability receipt
downstream_semantics: Does not imply coordinate absent in other surveys

trigger: Both endpoint facts/coordinates are individually governed but no rule says they are semantically comparable
provenance_required: Actor fact authority; empirical coordinate authority; requested mapping
downstream_semantics: Endpoint authority does not compose automatically

trigger: Actor and survey fields measure different constructs despite similar labels
provenance_required: Both semantic definitions; comparator negative rule
downstream_semantics: Examples: belief vs affiliation; individual income vs household income when no conversion exists

trigger: Mapping requires unit/category normalization but no governed normalizer/crosswalk is supplied
provenance_required: Raw values; unit/taxonomy refs; comparator request
downstream_semantics: No ad-hoc recoding or best-effort conversion

trigger: A crosswalk family exists conceptually but requested source/time cannot resolve an exact version/hash
provenance_required: Crosswalk family ref; source/time; unresolved version receipt
downstream_semantics: Mutable latest is forbidden

trigger: Exact crosswalk version exists but actor value has no mapped empirical value
provenance_required: Crosswalk version/hash; actor value; coverage status
downstream_semantics: Unmapped != nearest category

trigger: Actor value maps to several empirical categories and rule supplies no composition/selection semantics
provenance_required: Crosswalk; candidate mapped values; comparator rule
downstream_semantics: Do not choose first, modal, nearest, or highest-support category

trigger: Several empirical fields could measure actor property and no authority chooses alternative/conjunctive use
provenance_required: All candidate coordinate refs/authorities; comparator request
downstream_semantics: No automatic OR/AND to increase support

trigger: Rule explicitly recognizes several alternative source measures
comparability_action: Emit typed alternative predicate set or separate query instructions as rule specifies
provenance_required: Rule ID/version; each coordinate/predicate; alternative semantics
downstream_semantics: Alternatives are not automatically unioned

trigger: Rule explicitly requires several empirical predicates jointly
provenance_required: Rule ID/version; component predicates; conjunction authority/hash
downstream_semantics: Inherits D07: individual permissions do not authorize conjunction composition

trigger: Scalar-to-band comparison requested without exact interval boundaries/inclusivity/unit
provenance_required: Actor scalar; empirical band taxonomy; missing interval rule
downstream_semantics: No conventional age/income band assumption

trigger: Authorized interval system exists but actor scalar belongs to no valid empirical band
comparability_action: Return no-match or invalid-input state according to rule
provenance_required: Interval version; actor value; validity rules
downstream_semantics: No clipping into nearest band

trigger: Actor fact time and survey reference time relation is not governed
provenance_required: Actor effective time; survey wave/year/fieldwork refs; requested alignment mode
downstream_semantics: No silent contemporaneous or life-stage assumption

trigger: Exact temporal rule exists but actor fact interval cannot lawfully match survey reference period
comparability_action: Return no comparator for this survey scope
provenance_required: Temporal rule; both intervals/reference times
downstream_semantics: No backdating or future-proxy leakage

trigger: Survey year/wave label is insufficient for required exact temporal relation
comparability_action: Return missing fieldwork-time authority or use coarser comparator only if rule explicitly permits
provenance_required: Wave/year metadata; required precision; missing authority
downstream_semantics: Year equality is not fabricated exact date equality

trigger: Residence/place comparison requires containment/boundary mapping without a governed historical geography authority
provenance_required: Actor place ref; survey geography code; requested time
downstream_semantics: No proximity or string matching

trigger: Historical place maps to several administrative units/boundary interpretations at relevant time
comparability_action: Return ambiguity unless rule defines exact historical mapping
provenance_required: Boundary version; candidate regions; effective dates
downstream_semantics: No nearest or present-day boundary fallback

trigger: Governed hierarchy proves actor locality is not within any admissible survey region/category for scope
provenance_required: Hierarchy/version; actor place; empirical regions
downstream_semantics: Nonmatch does not authorize adjacent-region substitution

trigger: Comparator rule is source-specific but source/wave/country scope is absent or ambiguous
provenance_required: Candidate sources/scopes; rule applicability
downstream_semantics: No broadening across surveys

trigger: Same normalized field exists across sources but source-native construct equivalence is not governed
comparability_action: Use only source whose native semantics are independently certified; otherwise no comparator
provenance_required: Normalized alias; native fields; source authorities
downstream_semantics: Normalized name does not create cross-survey equivalence

trigger: Comparator is valid but a historical respondent lacks the selected coordinate value
comparability_action: Exclude/handle under D08 risk-set/missingness authority; never treat as actor match
provenance_required: Empirical predicate; risk-set/missingness policy
downstream_semantics: Respondent missingness affects empirical denominator, not comparator identity

trigger: Survey coordinate or target is DK/refusal/IAP/not-asked/inapplicable under typed semantics
provenance_required: State authority; routing/applicability refs
downstream_semantics: Special state is not ordinary category equality

trigger: Mapping attempts CAN-006/ADP-009 generated position -> survey demographic coordinate
provenance_required: Generated-position fact/ref; negative D10/corrective authority
downstream_semantics: D12D requires ontology-2 actor fact, not structural-position binding

trigger: Mapping attempts actor belief/epistemic stance -> survey religion/ethnicity/language/etc demographic coordinate
provenance_required: ADP-017 state/ref; empirical construct; negative rule
downstream_semantics: Belief != self-identification/affiliation/demography

trigger: Mapping attempts actor memory -> objective migration/travel/residence/household fact
comparability_action: Reject unless survey construct explicitly measures recalled/self-reported memory and separate rule says so
provenance_required: ADP-016 memory ref; objective history refs; survey construct
downstream_semantics: Memory/accessibility != objective event history

trigger: Current/later actor response is used retroactively to select comparator population for an earlier reverse inference
comparability_action: Reject absent separately governed anti-circular response-conditioned query
provenance_required: Actor response time; requested empirical query time; negative rule
downstream_semantics: Prevents posterior leakage masquerading as prior comparability

trigger: Population prevalence or modal category is used to fill a missing actor fact
provenance_required: Missing actor state; attempted prevalence source
downstream_semantics: Population prevalence != actor membership

trigger: All candidate mappings were lawfully evaluated and none is applicable, without missing authority or ambiguity
provenance_required: Complete candidate-rule receipts; negative/not-applicable reasons
downstream_semantics: Valid-empty is not missing authority and does not imply unconditioned fallback

trigger: Required actor fact, empirical authority, temporal binding or crosswalk may become available later and rule marks request deferrable
provenance_required: Missing dependency refs; retry condition/version
downstream_semantics: No fabricated interim predicate

trigger: Hash/version/provenance conflict or inconsistent immutable inputs
provenance_required: Conflicting refs/hashes; integrity receipt
downstream_semantics: Never continue with best-effort comparator

trigger: All endpoint authorities, comparator rule, normalization, time/source scope and ambiguity law verify
comparability_action: Construct exact D08 empirical predicate and provenance receipt
provenance_required: Actor fact + owner; comparator rule; crosswalk/time/geography refs; survey coordinate authority; resolved predicate
downstream_semantics: Output is empirical possibility-field conditioner only; no actor-state or structural-position consequence
